description: You are a sustainability specialist hired to identify environmental hotspots in the life cycle of a construction material. Using openLCA and the USLCI database at ~/LCA_Imports/uslci_database.zip (LCIA methods at ~/LCA_Imports/lcia_methods.zip), conduct a supply chain hotspot analysis for a cement or concrete production process. You must: (1) import the database and LCIA methods, (2) find a cement or ready-mix concrete process in the USLCI database, (3) build a product system that expands the upstream supply chain with at least 4 linked upstream processes resolved, (4) run a full LCIA calculation to determine the Global Warming Potential, (5) perform a process contribution analysis to identify which upstream processes contribute most to total GWP, and (6) export the contribution analysis as ~/LCA_Results/hotspot_analysis.csv listing each upstream process by name alongside its percentage contribution to total GWP. Processes contributing less than 1% may be grouped as 'Other'.
